l.i: Cum Christus, ait, se facturum dicit, quicquid
patrem Deum in ipsius nomine rogarent, satis
significat, Rogare patrem in Christi nomine
nihil aliud esse quam patrem rogare, ad ipsum Christum

main_text.l: preces dirigendo. Sic ille, Epist. de Invoc. Christi,
p. 355. Tom. 1. Sed e contra. Licet non existi-
memus, Christum in statu Gloriae collocatum, pro

page.notes: Heavy show-through and smudging across the whole page; many words in the middle and lower lines are read with difficulty. "insigatur" and "protersus" are doubtful. Where the text reads "Christus" and "Christum" in the same sentence, the printed forms were copied as they appear. The line "Pag. 231." and the references "Jo. 14. 13, 14." and "15. 16." sit inside the text column and were kept as running text. The word "dum" at the foot is the catchword. No marginal notes, signature or other furniture visible.
